description: A pure storage provider: it implements the {@code ArtifactStore} SPI and is discovered through {@code provides}, so the server adds it to its module graph at deploy time and selects it with {@code jenesis.repository.store=gcs}, with no compile-time dependency from the server. Unlike the {@code s3} backend, the version token is the object generation ({@code x-goog-generation}), because GCS honours {@code If-Match} / {@code If-None-Match} only on reads - conditional writes go through GCS's own {@code x-goog-if-generation-match} precondition instead (see {@code GcsArtifactStore}). The AWS SDK closure below is the {@code s3} backend's, resolved transitively through Maven and pinned here.
